definitions.full: H6969. qonen [ קוֺנֵן ] verb denominative Po`l. chant a קִינָה ; — Perfect 3plural consecutive וְקוֺנְנוּ Ezek 27:32 ( עַל person), suffix (cognate) וְקוֺנְוּהָ 32:16 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְקֹנֵן 2Sam 1:17 (with accusative of congnate meaning with verb + עַל person), compare ( עַל person only), 2Chr 35:25 and ( אֶל person) 2Sam 3:33 ; 3 feminine plural תְּקוֺנֶנָּה with accusative of congnate meaning with verb, Ezek 32:16 , + עַל person 32:16 ; Participle as substantive Jer 9:16 (professional) wailing women.
